There is a new Bass Pi - Restricted Launcher (Kiosk) build released for the Raspberry Pi 4/4b/rpi400.
This build is special and includes a boot menu to switch between Lockdown and Admin modes.

Head over to GitHub to check it out:
https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/bass-rpi/releases/tag/restricted/v14.0-20241002224933
